items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Bobby Cranshaw got me involved with Joe in a couple of things.

ctx.x: So that was good. But I loved — Bobby Cranshaw got me involved with Joe in a couple of things. But he was fun to play behind. But Norman Simmons owned that gig. He owned that gig.
Sure. Well Joe helped us actually get this whole project started actually.
